It also adds a `find_package(zstd CONFIG REQUIRED)` call to link against the system `zstd::libzstd` target.

These changes are consistent with standard packaging practices, particularly in Linux distributions like Arch, where using system libraries instead of bundled ones is preferred for security, maintainability, and binary size reasons. The patch does not introduce any network operations, file manipulations, or execution of external code. It does not contain obfuscated content or suspicious commands.

The modifications are focused solely on build configuration and header inclusion paths, which are normal and safe changes in the context of packaging. There is no evidence of malicious intent or supply-chain attack vectors.
